name: workshop-recap
description: Turn a finished workshop capstone into one polished, self-contained HTML showcase page, built from the project's own generated content and an evidenced inventory of the agent capabilities it uses

interface.shortDescription: Summarize a finished capstone project as one self-contained HTML page.
interface.longDescription: Scan a capstone project for the content it already generated — agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), subagent definitions, hooks and settings, authored skills, MCP servers, design specs, CI workflows, and infrastructure-as-code — then render a single self-contained HTML showcase: detailed overview, live demo capture, architecture, and an inventory of which agent capabilities the project actually exercised. Every claim cites the real file it came from; anything unevidenced is omitted rather than invented.
defaultPrompt: 지금까지 만든 산출물을 정리해서 html로 만들어줘
Summarize my capstone project as a single HTML showcase page.
